verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly state 'No API key management - just sign in with your Google account' (gemini-cli-gh-13), directly matching the story. However, community reports show caveats: Workspace accounts are blocked from login entirely (gemini-cli-comm-4), and paying Gemini subscribers found personal-account sign-in doesn't grant extra usage without a separate Code Assist Standard/Enterprise tier (gemini-cli-comm-3), muddying the 'free-tier' promise. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of actual free-tier quota limits, and no contradiction of the Workspace-account login friction.
